ch2-01.javascript: function Sum(a,b) { const reference = function solve(a,b) { return a+b; }; return reference(a,b); }

ch2-02.javascript: function Perimeter(width,height) { const reference = function solve(width,height) { return width+width+height+height; }; return reference(width,height); }

ch2-03.javascript: function Seconds(minutes) { const reference = function solve(minutes) { return minutes*6*10; }; return reference(minutes); }

ch2-05.javascript: function DigitSum3(n) { const reference = function solve(n) { return [...String(n)].reduce((s,c)=>s+Number(c),0); }; return reference(n); }

ch2-06.javascript: function Reverse3(n) { const reference = function solve(n) { return Number([...String(n)].reverse().join("")); }; return reference(n); }

ch2-07.javascript: function Clock(seconds,elapsed) { const reference = function solve(seconds,elapsed) { const total=seconds+elapsed;return total-Math.floor(total/86400)*86400; }; return reference(seconds,elapsed); }

ch2-08.javascript: function Boxes(items,capacity) { const reference = function solve(items,capacity) { return Math.ceil(items/capacity); }; return reference(items,capacity); }

ch2-09.javascript: function ProgressionSum(first,step,count) { const reference = function solve(first,step,count) { return first*count+step*(count*(count-1)/2); }; return reference(first,step,count); }

ch3-01.javascript: function IsEven(n) { const reference = function solve(n) { return (n&1)===0; }; return reference(n); }

ch3-02.javascript: function Sign(n) { const reference = function solve(n) { return n<0?-1:n>0?1:0; }; return reference(n); }

ch3-03.javascript: function Max3(a,b,c) { const reference = function solve(a,b,c) { return [a,b,c].reduce((m,v)=>v>m?v:m); }; return reference(a,b,c); }

ch3-05.javascript: function Triangle(a,b,c) { const reference = function solve(a,b,c) { if(a+b<=c||a+c<=b||b+c<=a)return "invalid";const equal=Number(a===b)+Number(a===c)+Number(b===c);return equal===3?"equilateral":equal?"isosceles":"scalene"; }; return reference(a,b,c); }

ch3-06.javascript: function DaysInMonth(month,year) { const reference = function solve(month,year) { if(month===2)return year%400===0||(year%4===0&&year%100!==0)?29:28;return [4,6,9,11].includes(month)?30:31; }; return reference(month,year); }

ch3-08.javascript: function NextDate(day,month,year) { const reference = function solve(day,month,year) { const leap=year%400===0||(year%4===0&&year%100!==0);const lens=[31,leap?29:28,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31];if(day<lens[month-1])return [day+1,month,year];return month===12?[1,1,year+1]:[1,month+1,year]; }; return reference(day,month,year); }

ch3-09.javascript: function Bill(units) { const reference = function solve(units) { let sum=0;for(let i=1;i<=units;i++)sum+=i<=50?2:i<=100?3:5;return sum; }; return reference(units); }

ch4-01.javascript: function SumToN(n) { const reference = function solve(n) { let sum=0,lo=1,hi=n;while(lo<=hi){sum+=lo===hi?lo:lo+hi;lo++;hi--;}return sum; }; return reference(n); }

ch4-02.javascript: function Factorial(n) { const reference = function solve(n) { let product=1;for(let k=n;k>1;k--)product*=k;return product; }; return reference(n); }

ch4-04.javascript: function ReverseNumber(n) { const reference = function solve(n) { const digits=String(n);let text='';for(let i=digits.length-1;i>=0;i--)text+=digits[i];return Number(text); }; return reference(n); }

ch4-05.javascript: function Gcd(a,b) { const reference = function solve(a,b) { let shift=0;while(((a|b)&1)===0){a>>=1;b>>=1;shift++;}while((a&1)===0)a>>=1;do{while((b&1)===0)b>>=1;if(a>b)[a,b]=[b,a];b-=a;}while(b!==0);return a*2**shift; }; return reference(a,b); }

ch4-06.javascript: function IsPrime(n) { const reference = function solve(n) { if(n<2)return false;const composite=new Uint8Array(n+1);for(let p=2;p*p<=n;p++)if(!composite[p])for(let j=p*p;j<=n;j+=p)composite[j]=1;return composite[n]===0; }; return reference(n); }

ch4-07.javascript: function PrimeCount(n) { const reference = function solve(n) { const primes=[];for(let v=2;v<=n;v++){let ok=true;for(const p of primes){if(p*p>v)break;if(v%p===0){ok=false;break;}}if(ok)primes.push(v);}return primes.length; }; return reference(n); }

ch4-08.javascript: function IsPerfect(n) { const reference = function solve(n) { let sum=0;for(let d=1;d<=Math.floor(n/2);d++)if(n%d===0)sum+=d;return sum===n; }; return reference(n); }

ch4-09.javascript: function Fibonacci(n) { let a = 0, b = 1; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) [a, b] = [b, a + b]; return a }

ch5-01.javascript: function LastWordLength(s) { const reference = s=>s.split(' ').filter(Boolean).at(-1).length; return reference(s); }

ch5-02.javascript: function FindFirst(text,pattern) { const reference = (text,pattern)=>{const pi=Array(pattern.length).fill(0);for(let i=1,j=0;i<pattern.length;i++){while(j&&pattern[i]!==pattern[j])j=pi[j-1];if(pattern[i]===pattern[j])j++;pi[i]=j}for(let i=0,j=0;i<text.length;i++){while(j&&text[i]!==pattern[j])j=pi[j-1];if(text[i]===pattern[j])j++;if(j===pattern.length)return i-j+1}return -1}; return reference(text,pattern); }

ch5-04.javascript: function ReverseWords(s) { const reference = s=>{const words=[];let i=s.length-1;while(i>=0){while(i>=0&&s[i]===' ')i--;let end=i;while(i>=0&&s[i]!==' ')i--;if(end>i)words.push(s.slice(i+1,end+1))}return words.join(' ')}; return reference(s); }

ch5-05.javascript: function LongestUnique(s) { const reference = s=>{const set=new Set();let l=0,best=0;for(let r=0;r<s.length;r++){while(set.has(s[r]))set.delete(s[l++]);set.add(s[r]);best=Math.max(best,r-l+1)}return best}; return reference(s); }

ch5-06.javascript: function Anagram(s,t) { const reference = (s,t)=>{if(s.length!==t.length)return false;const m=new Map();for(const c of s)m.set(c,(m.get(c)||0)+1);for(const c of t){if(!m.get(c))return false;m.set(c,m.get(c)-1)}return true}; return reference(s,t); }

ch5-08.javascript: function EditDistance(a,b) { const reference = (a,b)=>{const memo=new Map();function f(i,j){if(i===a.length)return b.length-j;if(j===b.length)return a.length-i;const k=i+','+j;if(memo.has(k))return memo.get(k);const v=a[i]===b[j]?f(i+1,j+1):1+Math.min(f(i+1,j),f(i,j+1),f(i+1,j+1));memo.set(k,v);return v}return f(0,0)}; return reference(a,b); }

ch5-09.javascript: function SubsequenceCount(s,t) { const reference = (s,t)=>{const memo=new Map();function f(i,j){if(j===t.length)return 1;if(i===s.length)return 0;const k=i+','+j;if(memo.has(k))return memo.get(k);const v=f(i+1,j)+(s[i]===t[j]?f(i+1,j+1):0);memo.set(k,v);return v}return f(0,0)}; return reference(s,t); }

ch6-01.javascript: function Absolute(n) { const reference = n=>Math.abs(n); return reference(n); }

ch6-02.javascript: function Power(baseValue,exponent) { const reference = (b,e)=>{let p=1;while(e){if(e%2)p*=b;e=Math.floor(e/2);if(e)b*=b}return p}; return reference(baseValue,exponent); }

ch6-03.javascript: function Minimum(a,b) { const reference = (a,b)=>Math.min(a,b); return reference(a,b); }

ch6-04.javascript: function Lcm(a,b) { const reference = (a,b)=>{function gcd(x,y){let shift=0;while(x%2===0&&y%2===0){x/=2;y/=2;shift++}while(x%2===0)x/=2;while(y){while(y%2===0)y/=2;if(x>y)[x,y]=[y,x];y-=x}return x*2**shift}return a/gcd(a,b)*b}; return reference(a,b); }

ch6-05.javascript: function PalindromeNumber(n) { const reference = n=>{let k=n,r=0;do{r=r*10+k%10;k=Math.floor(k/10)}while(k);return r===n}; return reference(n); }

ch6-06.javascript: function Divisors(n) { const reference = n=>{const lo=[],hi=[];for(let d=1;d*d<=n;d++)if(n%d===0){lo.push(d);if(d*d!==n)hi.push(n/d)}return lo.concat(hi.reverse())}; return reference(n); }

ch6-07.javascript: function Choose(n,k) { const reference = (n,k)=>{k=Math.min(k,n-k);let r=1;for(let i=1;i<=k;i++)r=r*(n-k+i)/i;return r}; return reference(n,k); }

ch6-08.javascript: function DigitalRoot(n) { const reference = n=>{function digitSum(v){return [...String(v)].reduce((s,c)=>s+Number(c),0)}while(n>9)n=digitSum(n);return n}; return reference(n); }

ch6-09.javascript: function PrimesInRange(left,right) { const reference = (left,right)=>{function prime(v){if(v<2)return false;if(v===2)return true;if(v%2===0)return false;for(let d=3;d<=Math.floor(Math.sqrt(v));d+=2)if(v%d===0)return false;return true}let count=0;for(let v=left;v<=right;v++)if(prime(v))count++;return count}; return reference(left,right); }

ch7-02.javascript: function MaxProfit(prices) { const reference = prices=>{let high=prices.at(-1),best=0;for(let i=prices.length-2;i>=0;i--){best=Math.max(best,high-prices[i]);high=Math.max(high,prices[i])}return best}; return reference(prices); }

ch7-03.javascript: function PlusOne(digits) { const reference = digits=>{const a=[...digits];let last=-1;for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(a[i]!==9)last=i;if(last<0)return [1,...Array(a.length).fill(0)];a[last]++;for(let i=last+1;i<a.length;i++)a[i]=0;return a}; return reference(digits); }

ch7-04.javascript: function MaxSubarray(nums) { const reference = nums=>{let prefix=0,least=0,best=-Infinity;for(const x of nums){prefix+=x;best=Math.max(best,prefix-least);least=Math.min(least,prefix)}return best}; return reference(nums); }

ch7-06.javascript: function SearchRotated(nums,target) { const reference = (nums,target)=>{if(!nums.length)return -1;let lo=0,hi=nums.length-1;while(lo<hi){const mid=(lo+hi)>>1;if(nums[mid]>nums[hi])lo=mid+1;else hi=mid}const pivot=lo;lo=0;hi=nums.length-1;while(lo<=hi){const mid=(lo+hi)>>1,i=(mid+pivot)%nums.length;if(nums[i]===target)return i;if(nums[i]<target)lo=mid+1;else hi=mid-1}return -1}; return reference(nums,target); }

ch7-07.javascript: function FirstMissingPositive(nums) { const reference = nums=>{const a=[...nums],n=a.length;for(let i=0;i<n;i++)if(a[i]<=0||a[i]>n)a[i]=n+1;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const x=Math.abs(a[i]);if(x<=n)a[x-1]=-Math.abs(a[x-1])}for(let i=0;i<n;i++)if(a[i]>0)return i+1;return n+1}; return reference(nums); }

ch7-08.javascript: function TrappedWater(heights) { const reference = heights=>{const stack=[];let total=0;for(let i=0;i<heights.length;i++){while(stack.length&&heights[i]>heights[stack.at(-1)]){const bottom=stack.pop();if(!stack.length)break;const left=stack.at(-1);total+=(Math.min(heights[left],heights[i])-heights[bottom])*(i-left-1)}stack.push(i)}return total}; return reference(heights); }

ch7-09.javascript: function Candy(ratings) { const reference = ratings=>{let total=1,up=0,down=0,peak=0;for(let i=1;i<ratings.length;i++){if(ratings[i]>ratings[i-1]){up++;peak=up;down=0;total+=up+1}else if(ratings[i]===ratings[i-1]){up=down=peak=0;total++}else{up=0;down++;total+=down+1;if(peak>=down)total--}}return total}; return reference(ratings); }

ch8-02.javascript: function Transpose(matrix) { const reference = matrix=>{const out=Array.from({length:matrix[0].length},()=>[]);for(const row of matrix)row.forEach((x,j)=>out[j].push(x));return out}; return reference(matrix); }

ch8-03.javascript: function DiagonalSum(matrix) { const reference = matrix=>matrix.flatMap((row,i)=>row.filter((_,j)=>i===j||i+j===matrix.length-1)).reduce((s,x)=>s+x,0); return reference(matrix); }

ch8-04.javascript: function Spiral(matrix) { const reference = matrix=>{const r=matrix.length,c=matrix[0].length,seen=Array.from({length:r},()=>Array(c).fill(false)),directions=[[0,1],[1,0],[0,-1],[-1,0]],out=[];let i=0,j=0,d=0;for(let k=0;k<r*c;k++){out.push(matrix[i][j]);seen[i][j]=true;let x=i+directions[d][0],y=j+directions[d][1];if(x<0||x>=r||y<0||y>=c||seen[x][y]){d=(d+1)%4;x=i+directions[d][0];y=j+directions[d][1]}i=x;j=y}return out}; return reference(matrix); }

ch8-05.javascript: function ZeroRowsCols(matrix) { const reference = matrix=>{const a=matrix.map(row=>[...row]),r=a.length,c=a[0].length,firstRow=a[0].includes(0),firstCol=a.some(row=>row[0]===0);for(let i=1;i<r;i++)for(let j=1;j<c;j++)if(a[i][j]===0)a[i][0]=a[0][j]=0;for(let i=1;i<r;i++)for(let j=1;j<c;j++)if(a[i][0]===0||a[0][j]===0)a[i][j]=0;if(firstRow)a[0].fill(0);if(firstCol)for(const row of a)row[0]=0;return a}; return reference(matrix); }

ch8-06.javascript: function Rotate(matrix) { const reference = matrix=>{const a=matrix.map(row=>[...row]).reverse();for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<a.length;j++){const x=a[i][j];a[i][j]=a[j][i];a[j][i]=x}return a}; return reference(matrix); }

ch8-07.javascript: function MaxRectangle(matrix) { const reference = matrix=>{const width=matrix.map(row=>row.map(()=>0));let best=0;for(let i=0;i<matrix.length;i++)for(let j=0;j<matrix[0].length;j++){if(!matrix[i][j])continue;width[i][j]=1+(j?width[i][j-1]:0);let w=width[i][j];for(let top=i;top>=0;top--){w=Math.min(w,width[top][j]);if(!w)break;best=Math.max(best,w*(i-top+1))}}return best}; return reference(matrix); }

ch8-09.javascript: function MinimumHealth(grid) { const reference = grid=>{const r=grid.length,c=grid[0].length;function feasible(initial){const remaining=Array(c).fill(-Infinity);for(let i=0;i<r;i++)for(let j=0;j<c;j++){const prior=i===0&&j===0?initial:Math.max(i?remaining[j]:-Infinity,j?remaining[j-1]:-Infinity),now=prior+grid[i][j];remaining[j]=now>=1?now:-Infinity}return remaining[c-1]>=1}let lo=1,hi=1+100*(r+c-1);while(lo<hi){const mid=(lo+hi)>>1;if(feasible(mid))hi=mid;else lo=mid+1}return lo}; return reference(grid); }
